title: Layer display config
description: How one data layer is shown in the web map: pipeline/layers/<layer>.style.json. The pipeline validates it, resolves it and writes the result into that layer's manifest.json entry as `display` (see $defs/display). ADR 0007; docs/design/02_data_layers_and_popups.md.

$schema.description: Optional, for editors: the path to this schema.

title.description: Human-readable layer name, shown in the layer list and legends.

defaultVisible.description: Whether the layer is switched on when the map opens.

order.description: Draw order: layers are drawn in ascending order (the highest on top, and first in the layer list), ties broken by layer name. Defaults to 0.

layers.description: Raw MapLibre style-spec layers for a vector layer, in draw order (last on top), without `source` or `source-layer`, which the pipeline and the app fill in. Each `id` must be unique within the file; it is prefixed with `<layer>-` on the map. Not for raster layers, which use the raster `symbology`.

not.description: A layer has a pop-up or a modal for click details, not both.

color.description: A CSS colour, as MapLibre accepts it, for example #2c7fb8.

fallback.description: Colour for features that match no category or have no numeric value. Without a label it is left out of the legend.

singleColor.description: Every feature in one colour. The legend label defaults to the layer title.

categoricalColor.description: One colour per value of a text attribute (MapLibre match).

steppedColor.description: Colour classes on a numeric attribute (MapLibre step). Either explicit `stops` (ascending `from`, each class running up to the next `from`, the last up to `max`, which is for the legend only) or `breaks` plus one colour per class in `colors`, which the pipeline resolves into stops from the data.

breaks.description: Class breaks computed by the pipeline from the layer's data: `equal` splits min to max into equal ranges; `quantile` puts about the same number of features in each class. `classes` must equal the number of `colors`.

interpolatedColor.description: A continuous colour gradient on a numeric attribute (MapLibre `interpolate`, linear), with a gradient legend. Either explicit `stops` (ascending `value`, at least two) or `colors` (2 to 12) spread evenly from `min` to `max`, each of which defaults to the attribute's minimum or maximum in the layer's data (resolved by the pipeline, like `breaks`). Values outside the range take the end colours; features without a numeric value take the `fallback`.

themeId.description: A colour theme id: unique within the layer.

theme.description: One named colour theme: what the "Colour by" choice in the layer panel switches to, in the browser, with no rebuild.

label.description: The name in the "Colour by" list, for example `Protected (%)`.

legend.description: An explicit legend for this theme, as the top-level `legend` is for a single `color`.

themes.description: Several named colour themes in place of one `color`: the map opens on `defaultTheme` (default: the first) and the layer panel offers a "Colour by" choice. Each theme has its own legend; the top-level `legend` is not used with themes.

polygonSymbology.description: Polygons: a fill coloured by `color` (or by switchable `themes`) with a thin outline.

pointSymbology.description: Points: circles coloured by `color` (or by switchable `themes`) with a contrasting stroke.

rasterSymbology.description: A binary raster layer (LAYER_TYPE=raster, ADR 0008): cells of 1 in `color`, everything else transparent. The tiles hold only the share of each pixel covered by 1 cells; colour and opacity are applied by the map (a MapLibre `color-relief` layer), so changing them needs no re-tiling. At lower zooms, the share covered shows as transparency, from fully transparent (none) to `opacity` (all). The legend label defaults to the layer title. Raster layers have no pop-up.

color.description: The colour of a 1 cell, as #rrggbb.

symbology.description: Shorthand that the pipeline expands into MapLibre style layers (polygon: `fill` and `outline`; point: `circle`; raster: `raster`, a `color-relief` layer) and a legend. `raster` is for raster layers only, and the only display a raster layer accepts.

styleLayer.description: A MapLibre style-spec layer without `source` and `source-layer`. In a config's raw `layers`, a vector layer type; `color-relief` appears only in a resolved display, expanded from the raster shorthand. Everything but `id`, `type` and the absent source fields is checked by the MapLibre style validator in the pipeline.

position.description: In a `gradient` legend, where the colour sits on the bar, from 0 (start) to 1 (end). Items without one (such as a no data colour) show as separate swatches.

legendKind.description: `ramp` for classes of a numeric value, `gradient` for a continuous colour ramp, `categories` for categories, `single` for one colour.

legendShape.description: Swatch shape: `square` for fills, `circle` for points, `line` for lines.

legend.description: An explicit legend, used as is in place of the derived one. Fields left out are taken from the derived legend when there is one, otherwise from the first style layer (shape), `categories` (kind), `transparent` (border) and 1 (opacity). Required when the legend cannot be derived from `layers`.

resolvedLegend.description: The legend as written to the manifest: every field set.

valueSource.description: Where a pop-up value comes from: a tile attribute, or the vector tile feature id.

numberFormat.description: How a number is shown: an optional `preset`, changed by any of `decimals`, `grouping` and `suffix`. Without a format, values are shown as they are.

suffix.description: Unit after the number, separated by a space (the `percent` preset's `%` has none).

formatPreset.description: A named number format: `number` (0 decimals, thousands separators), `count` (the same, for counts), `percent` (a value already 0 to 100: 1 decimal, then `%`), `hectares` (0 decimals, `ha`) and `km` (1 decimal, `km`).

format.description: A number format: a preset name, for example "percent", or a numberFormat object.

popup.description: The pop-up shown when a feature is clicked. Without one the layer is not clickable.

template.description: Text with attribute placeholders: `{attribute}` is the value of a tile attribute as it is, `{attribute:preset}` the value in a number format preset (for example `{area_ha:hectares}`), and `{$id}` the feature id.

cellAttribute.description: The attribute for one value, or null for none (an empty cell).

attributesBlock.description: A list of labelled values, as in a pop-up. An item the feature has no value for is hidden; with none left, the block is hidden.

tableBlock.description: A table of categories (rows) by attributes (columns). Each row gives one attribute per column in `values` (same length as `columns`). A missing value shows as n/a; a row with no values is hidden, and so is a table with no rows left.

rowHeader.description: Heading of the row label column (default none).

chartBlock.description: A Chart.js chart over `categories` (bars or slices). `bar` takes one or more `series`; several make a grouped bar chart with a series legend. `pie` and `doughnut` take exactly one. Each series gives one attribute per category in `attributes` (same length as `categories`). A missing value is a gap; a chart with no values is hidden.

title.description: Heading above the chart, also in its accessible label.

valueLabel.description: What the values are, for the accessible summary, for example `% cover`.

format.description: Number format of the values in tooltips and the accessible summary.

colors.description: Slice colours of a pie or doughnut, one per category (default: the app's palette).

textBlock.description: A paragraph; hidden when a placeholder has no value.

listBlock.description: A bulleted list of items from attributes, for example recommended actions and their reasons. An item shows when its `when` attribute, if given, is true (true, a number other than 0, or text other than empty, 0, false or no) and its text has a value for every placeholder. With no item to show, `empty` is shown; when the feature has none of the attributes at all, the block is hidden.

empty.description: Shown when no item applies, for example `No actions recommended.`

modalSection.description: A section of the modal: a heading, optional description text, then its blocks in order. Hidden when every block is hidden (or, with no blocks, when the description is).

tab.description: A shorter label for the section's tab in the `tabs` layout, for example `Threats` for `Direct threats`; default the heading. With a `tab`, the heading is also shown above the section's content. In the `tabs` layout, tab labels (or headings) must be unique within the modal.

modal.description: Click details in a modal dialog instead of a map pop-up: one template per layer, filled from the clicked feature's tile attributes, so adding a section is a config change only. A layer has `popup` or `modal`, not both; without either it is not clickable.

title.description: The heading; the layer title when a placeholder has no value.

subtitle.description: A line under the heading; hidden when a placeholder has no value.

layout.description: How the sections are shown. `tabs` (the default): a tab per section the feature has values for, one section at a time in a dialog of fixed size whose content scrolls; with only one such section, no tabs. `scroll`: every section one after another in a taller dialog that scrolls.

resolvedTheme.description: A colour theme as written to the manifest: the paint properties to set on the layer's style layers (by configured id) and the theme's legend.

paint.description: Style layer id to MapLibre paint properties and their values.

display.description: The resolved display config, as the pipeline writes it into the layer's manifest.json entry and the web app reads it: the shorthand expanded, breaks resolved and the legend filled in. With colour themes, `layers` and `legend` are those of `defaultTheme`, and `themes` lists every theme. Style layer ids are as in the config, without the `<layer>-` prefix.
